submission.justification: Mixture-G2 with a 2mm gas gap achieves the best time resolution of 0.901 ns among all tested configurations. This represents approximately 55% better performance than the next best option (G3 at 2mm: 1.233 ns) and more than 2x better than G1 configurations. The 2mm gap represents an optimal balance for this mixture, as both smaller (1mm: 1.026 ns) and larger (3mm: 1.038 ns) gaps show degraded performance.
